verdict.rationale: Unity's evidence covers scripting, MCP integration, CLI, build automation, and asset database syncing, but there is no mention of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back AI-driven automations/workflows specifically — no changelog, diff, approval, or rollback mechanism for automations is documented. Unity's Asset Database and general 'version control system' support (unity-docs-36) relate to project source files, not to auditing/rolling back automated agent actions.
